Those who escorted Paul brought him to Athens and then returned with instructions for Silas and Timothy to join him as soon as possible.

Paul and Barnabas appointed elders for them in each church, praying and fasting as they entrusted them to the Lord, in whom they had believed.
Then Paul answered, “Why are you weeping and breaking my heart? I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die in Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”
Be on the alert. Stand firm in the faith. Be men of courage. Be strong.
In fact, we rejoice when we are weak but you are strong, and our prayer is for your perfection.

if indeed you continue in your faith, established and firm, not moved from the hope of the gospel you heard, which has been proclaimed to every creature under heaven, and of which I, Paul, have become a servant.

that is, that you and I may be mutually encouraged by each otherʼs faith.
Now I urge you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, to join me in my struggle by praying to God for me.
so that by Godʼs will I may come to you with joy and together with you be refreshed.
Now I commend you for remembering me in everything and for maintaining the traditions, just as I passed them on to you.
But now He has reconciled you by Christʼs physical body through death to present you holy, unblemished, and blameless in His presence—
Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely, and may your entire spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
And this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight,
and to present her to Himself as a glorious church, without stain or wrinkle or any such blemish, but holy and blameless.
And the second is like it: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’
Be indebted to no one, except to one another in love. For he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
Beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
And we have come to know and believe the love that God has for us. God is love; whoever abides in love abides in God, and God in him.
